static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.family_status: Mother works as a palm reader in New Orleans
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends strained by gambling habits; though there are friends to talk to, has not yet disclosed the gambling problem to them
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar problems; no history of psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, steady speech rate, fairly cooperative; Neutral attitude, able to self-Reflect; feeling ashamed about the problem and disclosing cautiously

basic_info.main_problem: Spends excessively at the casino and believes that if the gambling continues, everything will eventually be lost; this behavioral and thinking pattern began a few months ago after one big win and gradually escalated, occurring more readily on weekends; limits are set but are hard to stick to.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to reduce the negative impact of gambling behavior on financial stability and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: A few months ago, experienced one 'big win' at the casino, from which strong excitement and expectation arose, and more frequent, higher-stakes gambling behavior gradually formed; it usually occurs more readily on weekends and self-set limits are hard to abide by.

Influence of the family of origin: the mother works as a palm reader and long-term makes judgmental comments (such as believing he should be more successful); the client internalized this as the feeling of being seen as a failure; although the mother still invites him to meals and cares about his recent status, the client often feels judged and ashamed.

core_beliefs: I am unable to control myself

special_situations.event: On weekends there is more free time, approaching or entering casino environments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not go or do not bet this time, I will miss a possible big win
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Setting a limit beforehand but constantly raising bets after entering to try to win back losses
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will be different; I can win back the losses.

special_situations.event: When under Work stress and Interpersonal tension
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not release stress through gambling, I will be unable to bear the current predicament
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses gambling as a way to escape stress and gain brief relaxation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I need to go to the casino to relax, otherwise the stress will crush me.

special_situations.event: Checking financial status or recalling recent gambling losses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I keep gambling, I will end up losing everything
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In catastrophizing worry, tries to recover losses by continuing to gamble
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will end up losing everything.

special_situations.event: Interacting with Mother or thinking of her past judgmental comments about being 'more successful'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing to meet Mother's expectations proves I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids revealing the problem to friends, reduces help-seeking to avoid shame and judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She feels I am a failure.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, to escape being evaluated as a failure and regain a sense of self-control
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and humiliated, fears losing everything (finances and self-esteem), fears relationships becoming further estranged
defense_goal: Reduces shame and others' judgment by keeping distance from others and concealing problems
Maintaining fragile self-esteem and hope by Rationalizing gambling as a way to relieve stress or 'win back losses'

object_relations.self_representation: A judged failure, an individual who can hardly control oneself
object_relations.object_representation: A critical Mother / others, judges who may care and be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on whether to seek support from friends or others and disclose the gambling problem
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client equates disclosing the problem with exposing shame, and will be harshly judged and disappointed like Mother (transference)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use seemingly rational reasons to Interpretation not seeking help (e.g. 'saying it now would not help me'), in a calm tone, avoiding concrete commitments, quickly Displacing to topics like stress or budget.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether Mother sees herself as a failure, or when Demanded to provide evidence and counterevidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting inner feelings of failure and shame as 'Mother thinks I am a failure', ignoring contrary evidence (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Asserting others' negative opinions in a certain tone, ignoring or downplaying counterevidence, ending the topic with brief sentences and pulling the discussion back to the practical difficulties caused by gambling.

manifestations: Uses gambling as a choice for coping with stress and a 'way of escape'
Difficulty with self-control ('once started, cannot stop')
Not disclosing the problem to friends, bearing shame and stress alone
Keeping distance for fear of being judged by others
outcomes: Reduced social support, the problem cycle reinforced

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Using self-Demands like 'I should be more successful' and 'I should be better'
Internalizing Mother's judgment as self-standards, seeing not yet achieving them as failure

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently blaming oneself as a 'failure', expressing caution
Not seeking help from friends out of shame, avoiding exposing the problem

positive_force: Willing to try changing and actively seeks counseling
Having some capacity for self-Reflection, able to identify catastrophizing and future-predicting thoughts
Realizing financial risks and damage to overall well-being
Has friend resources as potential support
negative_force: Weekend free time and the casino environment jointly trigger gambling behavior
Work and Interpersonal relationships stress make gambling an escape and relaxation method
Negative cognitions like catastrophizing and predicting the future maintain the problem cycle
Shame and Fear of judgment lead to not seeking help and hiding the problem
Mother's judgment internalized as strict self-standards, reinforcing the sense of failure

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive gambling and spending at the casino
antecedent: Having more free time on weekends
Excitement and expectation from a big win several months ago
Worrying about missing a potential big win (FOMO)
target_behavior.core_reason: Using gambling as a means to escape stress and gain brief pleasure; driven by the false expectation reinforced by 'big wins' and the belief in 'winning back losses'; accompanied by catastrophizing and future-predicting cognitions maintaining the behavior cycle
target_behavior.function: Escaping discomfort and stress in the short term, seeking excitement and hope, trying to 'make up losses' through gambling to recover self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Financial instability, impaired Work performance, Tense relationships with friends, worsened Anxiety and Fear, overall healthy lifestyle affected
